operational_failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first bounded template-replacement command was rejected by PowerShell before editing because its case-insensitive hashtable treated two differently cased replacement keys as duplicates.
operational_failed_witnesses.recovery: Used an explicitly ordered list of case-sensitive replacement pairs, then reviewed and patched the bounded owner-local files.
operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Use an ordered pair list rather than a PowerShell hashtable when replacement keys can differ only by letter case.

operational_failed_witnesses.failed_witness: The first bounded Python compilation command passed a wildcard path directly to py_compile on Windows, which does not expand shell globs, so it stopped on an invalid literal filename after changing no repository content.
operational_failed_witnesses.recovery: Expanded the exact owner-local runner file list in PowerShell and passed each resolved relative path separately to py_compile.
operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Materialize wildcard matches before invoking Python modules that do not perform their own filename expansion.

operational_failed_witnesses.recurrence_guard: Expand Windows wildcard paths before ripgrep and keep inherited-reference classification separate from current-owner stale-label review.
